$comment: Curated explanations for protocol-specific error codes. `id` matches exactly; `namePattern` is a regex on the contract name (deployer-agnostic). `sender` / `developer` may be null. Copy must describe every path that raises the code, not just the most common one.

u2001.name: ERR_NO_RESULT_DATA
u2001.summary: One step of this multi-step swap failed, but the router only records a generic code in its place, so the step's real error is not on chain.
u2001.sender: The whole route was cancelled and nothing moved. Retry with a simpler route or a smaller amount; if it repeats, the app can find the failing step by running the steps one at a time.
u2001.developer: Each fold helper begins with `(unwrap! result ERR_NO_RESULT_DATA)` on the accumulator, which discards the error of the step that failed. Bisect the route or replay steps individually at this block; consider carrying the failing index and code through the accumulator.

u2003.name: ERR_MINIMUM_RECEIVED
u2003.summary: The swap would have returned less than the minimum you set, so it was cancelled.
u2003.sender: Prices moved between quote and execution. Retry with a higher slippage tolerance or a smaller amount.

u2004.name: ERR_DEADLINE_PASSED
u2004.summary: The transaction was mined after the deadline the app set for it.
u2004.sender: Retry — the new transaction gets a fresh deadline.

u5001.name: ERR_NO_RESULT_DATA
u5001.summary: One of the positions in this batch failed, but the router only records a generic code in its place, so the position's real error is not on chain.
u5001.sender: The whole batch was cancelled and nothing moved. Retry with fewer positions; if it repeats, the app can find the failing position by submitting them one at a time.
u5001.developer: Each fold helper begins with `(unwrap! result ERR_NO_RESULT_DATA)` on the accumulator, which discards the error of the position that failed. Bisect the list or replay positions individually at this block (start with entries whose amounts are zero); consider carrying the failing index and code through the accumulator.

u1019.name: ERR_MINIMUM_X_AMOUNT
u1019.summary: You would have received less of one token than the minimum you set.
u1019.sender: Retry with a higher slippage tolerance.

u1023.name: ERR_MINIMUM_Y_AMOUNT
u1023.summary: You would have received less of one token than the minimum you set.
u1023.sender: Retry with a higher slippage tolerance.

u6009.name: ERR_MINIMUM_RECEIVED
u6009.summary: The swap would have returned less than the minimum you set.
u6009.sender: Retry with a higher slippage tolerance or a smaller amount.

u2005.name: ERR-EXCEEDS-MAX-SLIPPAGE
u2005.summary: The price moved more than the slippage you allowed.
u2005.sender: Retry with a higher slippage tolerance or a smaller amount.

u931.name: ERR_EMISSION_INTERVAL
u931.summary: Emissions can be minted at most once per block, and this block's emission was already minted.
u931.sender: Wait for the next block and try again.

u10153.name: err-oracle-no-fallback
u10153.summary: The market couldn't use an oracle price — the read failed its checks or the price moved beyond the allowed band — and no manual fallback was set, so it wasn't resolved.
u10153.sender: Nothing you can change: the market's governance (DAO or an authorised extension) has to set a manual price before resolution can proceed. Retrying only helps if the oracle problem was transient.
u10153.developer: Read the market's start price and the current oracle price to see which branch fired (oracle failure vs. move beyond `max-move-bips`). If the price moved out of band, `set-manual-price` (DAO-gated) is the intended remedy; widening `max-move-bips` changes semantics for every market.

u8403.name: ERR-SIGNATURES-NOT-UNIQUE
u8403.summary: The price update included duplicate signer signatures, so it was rejected.
u8403.developer: Each signature in the batch must come from a distinct signer.

u318.name: e03
u318.summary: The trade's value would have been below the minimum USD amount you set.
u318.sender: Retry with a lower minimum or a different amount.

u365.name: e07
u365.summary: After applying the plan's caps there was nothing left to trade.
u365.sender: Check the amount and direction, then retry.

u4278.name: ERR_COOLDOWN_ALREADY_SET
u4278.summary: An unstake cooldown is already in progress for this account.
u4278.sender: Wait for the current cooldown to finish before unstaking again.

u19.name: ERR_ALREADY_STAKED
u19.summary: Your STX are already stacked, so this request was rejected.
u19.sender: Nothing to do — the existing stacking stays in place.

u30.name: ERR_DISTRIBUTION_ALREADY_COMPLETE
u30.summary: Rewards for this cycle were already calculated.

u500.name: ERR_INVALID_ADDR_VERSION
u500.summary: The Bitcoin address type isn't supported for withdrawals.
u500.sender: Use a supported Bitcoin address type and retry.

u501.name: ERR_INVALID_ADDR_HASHBYTES
u501.summary: The Bitcoin address bytes were malformed.
u501.sender: Re-enter the Bitcoin address and retry.

u502.name: ERR_DUST_LIMIT
u502.summary: The withdrawal amount is below the minimum (dust limit).

u506.name: ERR_FEE_TOO_HIGH
u506.summary: The Bitcoin fee exceeded the maximum fee set on the request.

u400005.name: ERR-UNHEALTHY
u400005.summary: The borrow would leave your position under-collateralised.
u400005.sender: Borrow less or add collateral, then retry.

u400022.name: ERR-PRICE-FEED-UPDATE-FAILED
u400022.summary: The market couldn't update its price feed before the borrow.
u400022.sender: Not caused by you. Try again shortly.

u118.name: ERR-NAME-NOT-AVAILABLE
u118.summary: This name is already registered, so the claim was rejected.
u118.sender: Retrying the same claim cannot succeed. Check who holds the name and whether it has lapsed: an active name can only be bought from its owner; a lapsed one (past its grace period) is taken over through renewal, not through a new claim.
u118.developer: Check availability with the contract's read-only `get-bns-info` before broadcasting, and branch on the state you find (fresh claim vs. renewal of a lapsed name) instead of sending `name-claim-fast` regardless.

u125.name: ERR-FAST-MINTED-BEFORE
u125.summary: Someone registered this name before your preorder, so the register step was rejected.
u125.sender: The preorder path only wins when your preorder predates the other registration. The name is taken; buy it from the owner or wait for it to lapse.
